name: Voice Jab
description: Jab with a sharp word of sound that carries into the foe's chest on the heel of the blow.

name: Answering Hum
description: Answer the sound of an attack with a hum that cancels its beat before it lands.

name: Calling Step
description: Call a note to the far side of the foe and step into the place the call has made.

name: Voice Mapping
description: Call and listen so that the answers of the air draw a map of everything near.

name: Counter Voice
description: Meet the foe's blow with an opposing voice that throws it wide and strikes back in the same breath.

name: Harmony Veil
description: Wear two voices as a single veil whose harmony softens every blow that crosses it.

name: Pitched Pair
description: Pitch two notes against each other at the foe's ear until balance and aim fail together.

name: Voiced Cleave
description: Cleave through the guard with a stroke that sings in two voices and parts the guard along their beat.

name: Paired Aegis
description: Raise two interlocked shields of tone that guard the user from front and back at once.

name: Sundering Duet
description: Sing a high and a low voice through the field until their beating tears apart every guard and weapon inside it.

name: Cry Lance
description: Throw a short cry honed to a lance point at the foe's weakest seam.

name: Wingbeat Hush
description: Beat a soft hush of air about the body that turns light strikes like the wings of a hawk.

name: Dive Pace
description: Drop into a fast low pace that ends beneath the foe's guard.

name: Piercing Descent
description: Descend on the foe on a shrill falling note and pass through the strike to land a pace past it.

name: Hunting Ear
description: Hunt by ear across the field and fix on the one foe who is hiding their breath.

name: Rattling Cry
description: Rattle the foe's concentration with a harsh cry of alarm aimed at their ear.

name: Rending Shriek
description: Loose a shriek so fine and high that it tears through plate and the flesh behind it.

name: Ringing Pinions
description: Spread two pinions of ringing air at the shoulders that beat aside blows from above and from the flank.

name: Rending Stoop
description: Climb the field on a rising cry and then fall upon the foe in one stoop that rends guard and armor together.

name: Echo Rap
description: Rap on the foe's guard so that the hollow beneath it answers and rings back into the arm.

name: Echo Gathering
description: Gather the small echoes of the field into the chest and let them fill the muscles with strength.

name: Tapped Veil
description: Tap a veil of sound into place before the body so that it hangs in the air like a hung cloth.

name: Reverberant Step
description: Spring off an echo of the body and let the reverberation carry the step farther.

name: Echo Counting
description: Count the echoes that return from the field and number the bodies that threw them back.

name: Layered Echo
description: Stack echo upon echo in one blow so that each layer lands a heartbeat after the last.

name: Echo Sink
description: Sink the sound of every blow into a wide pool of echo before it can strike.

name: Collected Cry
description: Collect the cries of the fight into the user and turn their noise into steadier strength.

name: Cascading Echo
description: Cascade a falling run of echoes across the field so that each wave strikes harder than the last.

name: Echo Cage
description: Close an echo about one foe from every side so that they cannot move without being struck by their own noise.

name: Gathered Roar
description: Draw every echo of the field into one great body of sound and loose it as a single roar that flattens all before it.

name: Flowing Rap
description: Rap three times in one unbroken motion so that the blows blend into a single run.

name: Even Tone
description: Hold a level tone that makes a smooth surface of air for blows to slide across.

name: Glide Beat
description: Glide through a long beat in one smooth pace.

name: Tone Tracing
description: Trace a tone through its changes and follow it back to the one who made it.

name: Streaming Note
description: Stream a long thin note at a target several paces off and hold it until it bites.

name: Eddy Hum
description: Turn the foe's own sound into an eddy that sucks their balance in a circle.

name: Tone Mend
description: Pour a warm unbroken tone over an ally or the self until deep bruises fade and strained muscle recovers.

name: Surging Chord
description: Surge a heavy chord up from the ground through the foe in a single wave of force.

name: Purging Chord
description: Run a purging chord through an ally or the self that sweeps out poison and the backlash of a Qi Deviation.

name: Rushing Cadence
description: Gather the tone into a flood and loose it down the field as a rushing wave that sweeps a line of foes away.

name: Bell Tap
description: Tap the foe with a fingertip that rings like a struck bell and shakes the bones.

name: Bell Cover
description: Draw a bell-shaped cover of air over the user that rings away the force of blows.

name: Ring Listen
description: Ring a bell and listen to the way the ring is damped by whatever lies near.

name: Bronze Peal
description: Peal a bronze note through the body and strike with the weight of a cast bell.

name: Ringing Mend
description: Ring a soft bell over an ally or the self and let the ring draw torn flesh and strained bone back into place.

name: Dissonant Bell
description: Sound a bell badly out of tune so that the foe's focus and footing sour together.

name: Tolling Shatter
description: Toll a bell so heavy in the chest that the stroke shatters whatever it is aimed at.

name: Rekindling Chime
description: Chime softly over an ally whose breath and pulse have stopped moments ago and rekindle the faint life before it is gone.

name: Ruinous Toll
description: Toll the great azure bell once so that its note brings ruin to every foe and fragile thing within the field.

name: Drone Rap
description: Rap the foe while a low drone runs through the blow to give it a numbing weight.

name: Sustained Hum
description: Sustain one unbroken hum and let it thicken the air round the user into a guard.

name: Drone Step
description: Step in the long pull of a low drone so that the move is steady and hard to read.

name: Low Listening
description: Listen to the lowest sounds of the earth and feel the tread of heavy things approaching.

name: Weighing Drone
description: Lay a weighing drone upon one foe that bows their shoulders and slows every move.

name: Oath Drone
description: Hold the sworn drone of an oath to give the user and nearby allies steadier hands and breath.

name: Grinding Note
description: Grind a rough note against the foe's guard until the guard and the arm behind it falter.

name: Pressing Drone
description: Press a heavy drone over the field so that foes within are slowed and bowed as if under a great weight.

name: Pledge Hum
description: Hum a pledge that the guard will not break and the air round the user holds to it.

name: Oathbound Drone
description: Hold the drone of the oath over the whole field until every foe in it is pressed to the ground and cannot rise while the oath lasts.

name: Roar Rap
description: Rap with a throaty roar that hits the foe's body a breath before the knuckles.

name: Gusting Hum
description: Hum a gusting note that blows aside lighter strikes before they reach the body.

name: Pledged Stride
description: Take a pace that is promised to the wind and cannot be turned from its mark.

name: Roaring Lunge
description: Lunge in behind a roar that scatters the foe's attention and strike in the gap it opens.

name: Oath Hearing
description: Hear the true words in a foe's voice and know whether they keep their oath.

name: Vowed Guard
description: Raise a guard that is a vow made of sound and stays until the vow is spent.

name: Thunderous Vow
description: Call the vow aloud and strike with a boom that carries all its weight.

name: Rallying Roar
description: Roar the oath so that the user and every ally in earshot find their courage and strength at its pitch.

name: Sworn Roar
description: Swear the oath and call it down as a roar that thunders across the whole field and breaks all who stand against it.

name: Pitch Bearing
description: Take a bearing from the pitch of a call and hold the heading of the one who made it.

name: Plumb Rap
description: Rap straight down the line of the foe's guard with a knuckle that never wanders.

name: True Hum
description: Hum a true level note that sets the air before the user as straight and steady as a plumb line.

name: Bearing Stride
description: Stride along the line of a sounded bearing and arrive exactly at its end.

name: Pitch Lock
description: Lock the foe's movement to the pitch of a held note so that they cannot leave its line.

name: Straight Note
description: Send a note in a perfectly straight line through a gap in the foe's guard.

name: Correcting Tone
description: Sound a tone that corrects the user's drifting aim and brings every limb back onto the bearing.

name: Unwavering Note
description: Loose a note that never wavers and bores through whatever stands on its line.

name: True Ward
description: Hold a ward of perfect pitch that rejects every sound not set to its own bearing.

name: Unerring Pitch
description: Set a pitch to the exact note of one foe's being and sound it so that the harm passes through every defense.

name: Soundless Rap
description: Rap the foe in total silence so that the blow is felt but never heard.

name: Open Hush
description: Spread an open hush about the user that smothers the sound of any blow that nears.

name: Wide Listen
description: Listen wide across the quiet and notice each small movement within it.

name: Unheard Stride
description: Stride across the quiet in a way that no foe hears or feels.

name: Quiet Mend
description: Rest an ally or the self in a deep quiet where torn flesh and tired muscle recover.

name: Spreading Silence
description: Spread a silence over a few foes that dulls their hearing and the voice of their techniques.

name: Hush Lance
description: Thrust a lance of pure hush through a guard without any sound of its coming.

name: Silencing Clap
description: Clap once to drop a silence on the foe that cuts their call to a technique short.

name: Wide Smother
description: Smother the whole field in silence so that every foe within is struck dumb and sapped of force.

name: Quiet Cure
description: Draw poison taint or soul erosion out of an ally or the self into the still air where it fades.

name: Swallowing Hush
description: Open a hush so vast that it swallows the force of blows and spells aimed at the user and their allies and spends it in the quiet.

name: Fading Rap
description: Rap with a blow that seems to fade out but lands with its full ring a moment later.

name: Fading Guard
description: Let the guard fade to a whisper and let blows pass through it spent.

name: Last Step
description: Take the last step of a retreat and turn it into a sudden advance.

name: Dying Note
description: Strike on the last breath of a note when the foe expects the sound to be gone.

name: Echo Memory
description: Hear what sounds a place still holds as echoes and tell from them who passed through it recently.

name: Lingering Ring
description: Leave a lingering ring in the foe's ears that spoils their sense of where they are for a moment.

name: Echo Rebuke
description: Take the echo of a blow and send it back at the striker along with a rebuking strike.

name: Last Refrain
description: Close a long exchange with a refrain that gathers all the earlier notes into one blow.

name: Final Echo
description: Let every sound of the fight die and then call back the last echo of all of them as one blow that no guard can answer.
